Container.Name: omarchy-docker
Container.Overview: Headless Omarchy/Hyprland desktop streamed through Sunshine and Moonlight. REQUIRED INPUT SETUP: before starting this container, persist host/72-omarchy-sunshine-seat.rules on the Unraid boot device and install it into /etc/udev/rules.d from /boot/config/go; see the Requires field and project documentation. The container Sunshine process alone uses seat9. The narrowly matched host rule keeps its suffixed virtual devices away from the host seat, while the container private fake-udev view presents them to Hyprland as seat0. Normal unsuffixed host Sunshine devices remain unaffected. Use a custom Docker network with a dedicated IP; do not use host networking and do not add /dev/input, /run/udev, or /sys/class/input mounts.
Container.Requires: NVIDIA Container Toolkit and a locally built local/omarchy-unraid:latest image. Select a custom Docker network such as br0 and assign a dedicated unused IP; standard Sunshine ports are used directly on that IP. INPUT ISOLATION IS A HOST PREREQUISITE: copy host/72-omarchy-sunshine-seat.rules to /boot/config/omarchy-docker/, then add `modprobe uinput`, `install -m 0644 /boot/config/omarchy-docker/72-omarchy-sunshine-seat.rules /etc/udev/rules.d/72-omarchy-sunshine-seat.rules`, and `udevadm control --reload-rules` to /boot/config/go. Run all three commands once for the current boot, verify /dev/uinput exists, then recreate/restart this container. Unraid's /etc and loaded-module state are recreated at boot. Do not modify the host Sunshine service or global XDG_SEAT. Do not map host /dev/input, /run/udev, or /sys/class/input.

Config.Name: Sunshine configuration
Config.Description: Persistent Sunshine credentials, pairing state, and configuration.

Config.Name: Host cgroup
Config.Description: Host cgroup hierarchy required by systemd in the container.

Config.Name: DRI devices
Config.Description: DRM render and display devices.

Config.Name: uinput
Config.Description: Sunshine creates its seat9 virtual keyboard and mouse through uinput.

Config.Name: FUSE
Config.Description: FUSE device required by the desktop runtime.

Config.Name: TTY 0
Config.Description: Virtual terminal device required by the container session.

Config.Name: TTY 1
Config.Description: Virtual terminal device required by the container session.

Config.Name: NVIDIA GPU
Config.Description: UUID of the NVIDIA GPU assigned to Omarchy. Find it with nvidia-smi.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: Driver capabilities injected by NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

Config.Name: Sunshine base port
Config.Description: Keep the standard port on the dedicated container IP. Custom ports are not compatible with every Moonlight client.

Config.Name: Sunshine input seat
Config.Description: Applied only to container Sunshine. If changed, the host udev rule must match the same suffix.

Config.Name: Sunshine CSRF origins
Config.Description: Comma-separated trusted Web UI origins including scheme and port, for example https://192.168.1.250:47990.

Config.Name: Omarchy output
Config.Description: Name of the Hyprland headless output.

Config.Name: Resolution
Config.Description: Initial headless output resolution.

Config.Name: Refresh rate
Config.Description: Initial headless output refresh rate.

Config.Name: Display scale
Config.Description: Hyprland output scale.

Config.Name: Renderer
Config.Description: Renderer used by the headless Wayland session.

Config.Name: Allow empty libinput
Config.Description: Allows Hyprland to start before Sunshine creates virtual input devices.

Config.Name: DRM selection
Config.Description: Optional explicit DRM card, for example /dev/dri/card1. Leave blank unless Hyprland chooses the wrong GPU.
